# Fired Arts Logo font

`FiredArtsLogo-Regular.ttf` and `FiredArtsLogo-Regular.woff2` are installable web/desktop font files reconstructed from the lettering in the Fired Arts Studio logo.

The common ligatures `Fired`, `Arts`, and `Fired Arts` use vector contours traced directly from the supplied logo artwork, so those phrases reproduce the logo lettering rather than a merely similar font. The remaining Latin letters, numerals, punctuation, and diacritics use a matching connected-script companion style. It is intended for display text, headlines, and logo-adjacent materials rather than long body copy.

The companion glyph outlines are derived from Great Vibes, created by Robert E. Leuschke and distributed under the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1. The license is included in `OFL.txt`; the original project is documented at <https://github.com/googlefonts/great-vibes>.

## Use on the web

```css
@font-face {
  font-family: "Fired Arts Logo";
  src: url("/brand/fonts/FiredArtsLogo-Regular.woff2") format("woff2");
  font-weight: 400;
  font-style: normal;
  font-display: swap;
}
```

The TTF and WOFF2 files are the installable logo-derived font files used by the brand materials.
